name: GEORGE TUPOU I
description: George Tupou I united Tonga and became its first king. He established a modern government and introduced Tonga's first written constitution in 1875.

name: GEORGE TUPOU II
description: George Tupou II became king at a young age and ruled during a period when Tonga was a British protected state. His reign continued the monarchy established by his grandfather.

name: QUEEN SALOTE TUPOU III
description: Queen Sālote was Tonga's first and only queen regnant. She was well respected for strengthening Tongan culture, traditions, education, and national identity.

name: GEORGE TUPOU IV
description: Tupou IV ruled Tonga for more than 40 years. He was known for his strong leadership and played an important role in Tonga's development and international relations.

name: GEORGE TUPOU V
description: George Tupou V introduced important political changes during his short reign. He supported greater democratic representation and changes to Tonga's system of government.

name: GEORGE TUPOU VI
description: Tupou VI is the current king of Tonga. He continues to represent Tonga's traditions and culture while supporting the country's development and international relationships.
